SINDH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (FUNCTIONS) RULES, 1990
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 6th September, 1990]
NO. SOR‑I(SGA&WD)II/22‑80(Pt.I),
dated 4‑8‑1990.‑‑In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 10 of the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989, the Government of
Sindh arc pleased to make the following rule,,, namely:‑
1. (1) These rules may be
called the Sindh Public Service Commission (Functions) Rules, 1990.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. In these rules, unless there
is anything repugnant in the subject or context ‑---
(a) "Appointing
Authority" means an authority as defined in the Sindh Civil Servants
(Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1974;
(b) "Basic pay scale"
means the pay scale in which a post or group of posts is placed ;
(c) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Commission;
(d) "Department"
means an Administrative Department of the Secretariat under the Government
Rules of Business;
(e) "initial
appointment" means recruitment made otherwise than by promotion or
transfer;
(f) "Schedule" means
the Schedule to these rules;
(g) "Test" includes
either one or more from amongst the following as determined by the Commission:‑
(a) written examination;
(b) interview;
(c) viva voce.
3. (1) The Commission shall,
subject to other provisions of these rules, conduct tests for initial
recruitment to ‑‑
(i) civil posts connected with
the affairs of the Province in basic pay scales 16 to 22 except those specified
in the Schedule;
(ii) posts in or under a Corporation
or other body or organization set up by Government under any law for the time
being in force, carrying the Basic Pay Scale 17 or above, which may be referred
to the Commission; and
(iii) any other post which may
be referred by Government to the Commission.
(2) The Commission shall hold
Language Examination and such Departmental Examination as may be referred to it
under the Sindh Civil Servants (Departmental Examination) Rules, 1978:
Provided that written
competitive examination shall be conducted in all cases in which such
examination has been prescribed as the method of recruitment and the viva voce
shall be held only of those candidates who qualify in the written examination.
4. The Commission shall not
conduct tests for recruitment to posts which are to be filled‑----
(i) on contract for a specified
period; or
(ii) for a period of six months
or less pending selection of candidate on the basis of test conducted by the
Commission and for further period of six months with the approval of the Commission
if a requisition for filling the post wart sent to the Commission within two
months of the filling of the post on ad hoc basis and the Commission has failed
to nominate a candidate; or
(iii) without test by the order
of the Chief Minister.
5. The Chief Minister may, in
the public interest, specify posts which may be filled, without reference to
the Commission.
6. The Chairman may, in
relation to the filling of any posts constitute one or more Committees each
comprising at least two persons one of whom shall be nominated by the
Department concerned to which the post or posts belong.
7. (1) The advice of the
Commission shall ordinarily to be accepted by the Department in such cases in
which it is obligatory to consult the Commission.
(2) The advice of the
Commission shall be submitted to‑-----
(a) the Chief Secretary in
cases in which the Chief Minister or Chief Secretary is the appointing
authority; and
(b) the Secretary of the
concerned Department in the cases other than the cases mentioned in clause (a).
(3) If the advice of the
Commission submitted under sub‑rule (2) is not acceptable, the case shall
be submitted to the Chief Minister for orders.
8. The Sindh Public Service
Commission (Functions) Rules; 1974, are hereby repealed.
